name: Cboe Global Markets, Inc.
moat_justification: Exclusive SPX/VIX index licenses and liquidity network effects (~30% US options market share) give a real, regulation-backed moat with proven pricing power, and Data Vantage adds recurring high-margin data revenue. Held back from 8+ because earnings are concentrated in SPX/index options, geared to trading volumes and volatility regimes the company does not control, and multi-listed options/equities remain fiercely competitive.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 15.52 vs 3-yr median 9.46 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Strong-moat exchange franchise (7/10) priced past its earnings power — even on a current TTM base it returns 12.5% weighted at $292.25; it clears Andrew's 15% hurdle only at or below $225.41.
moat_for: Exclusive SPX and VIX index licenses
Liquidity network effects — ~30% US options market share
Proprietary market data (Data Vantage) — recurring, high-margin, pricing power
Regulatory licensing barriers and consolidated multi-asset platform
moat_against: Volume/volatility cyclicality — low-vol regime cuts transaction revenue
0DTE regulatory risk on the fastest-growing product
Competition from CME, ICE, Nasdaq, MIAX in multi-listed options and equities
